description: A configured maximum transmission length shorter than one D_PDU needs does not stop that D_PDU: the transmission is made just long enough for it, and nothing else is added beyond what fits in those blocks.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). Each S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is to SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 (the 648000-unit default, so TTD = request time + 1296000000 ms, A-0089, A-0091), and asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095). The CAS wraps the DATA S_PDU (priority, SAP 5 to SAP 5, TTD) in a DATA C_PDU (B-0297). Each D_PDU is type 7 NON-ARQ-DATA (C-0323, C-0575) with EOW 0, EMPTY (C-0398), address size 4, source 0.0.1.2, the whole C_PDU as its one segment (offset 0, C_PDU size = segment size, C-0343, C-0346), DELIVER IN ORDER clear (C-0333), C_PDU IDs allocated from 0 in placement order (C-0326, C-1040), and no pre-fill (D-0003). The air start of a D_PDU is the start of the block holding its first byte, preamble_ms + block x block_ms (C-1043); EOT = ceil((duration_ms - air start) / 500) (C-0104, C-0891, D-0005, D-0017), and the reception window is the same value because every copy of the C_PDU is in this transmission (C-0350, C-0352). The waveform is drc.default_speed, wn 2 long (C-0894). dts.max_transmission_ms 20000. Fixture: preamble 1000, flush 500, 100 bytes and 10000 ms a block, so the configured limit holds (20000 - 1500) / 10000 = 1 block. The first U_PDU (400 bytes) is a 431-byte D_PDU needing 5 blocks, so the transmission is that long (51500 ms, EOT 101) (C-0551, C-1042). The second (131 bytes) does not fit in what is left of those blocks, so it waits; on its own it needs 2 blocks, again more than the limit, so its transmission is 21500 ms (EOT 41). Between them: LBT 3000 after our own transmission (K-0074), one slot (K-0082). Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
